title: Akbar Socio Religious The Second Phase The Ibadat Khana
definition: The Ibadat Khana (House of Worship) was an assembly hall established by Akbar in 1575 at Fatehpur Sikri to facilitate intellectual discourse among theologians of various faiths, marking the transition from orthodox Sunni Islam to a policy of Sulh-i-kul (universal peace).
importanceInUpsc: This topic is central to understanding the evolution of Mughal secularism, the decline of the Ulema's political influence, and the ideological foundations of Akbar's later religious policies like Din-i-Ilahi.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Akbar Socio Religious The Second Phase The Ibadat Khana.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
